cohort: Women with a singleton live pregnancy >34 weeks gestation, with one previous cesarean delivery for a non-recurring cause, and willing to attempt VBAC, admitted to Rajkiya Mahila Chikitsalya, Ajmer, India over one year from July 2011 to June 2012.
finding: The VBAC success rate was higher in the induced labor group compared to the spontaneous labor group (57.33% vs. 50%), and success was also associated with a higher Bishop's score (>6) and prior successful VBAC.
